dedupe_keys.name: mod lsp vic model north american land surface parameters

description: MOD-LSP publishes land-surface parameters prepared for the Variable Infiltration Capacity hydrologic model, version 5 and later. The Zenodo release covers the continental United States, Mexico and southern Canada. Its NetCDF files combine soil and land-cover fractions with monthly leaf area, canopy fraction and albedo parameters derived from MODIS observations over 2000 to 2016. A modeller can use them to represent changing surface conditions when simulating runoff, water availability or heat flux relevant to dams and water supply. The parameters are formatted for the VIC image driver and are not directly interchangeable with every hydrologic model. Land-cover classifications and parameter vintages must be matched to the simulated period. Zenodo reports CC BY 4.0 for the data release. I read its own API metadata and the descriptor without downloading NetCDF files or running VIC. The code used to create the parameters is a separate resource item. A caveat is that values generated for the VIC image driver can require conversion for other hydrologic models.
